name: UP Post-Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Scheme
hindi_name: उत्तर प्रदेश दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
ministry_or_dept: Social Welfare & Backward Classes Welfare Dept, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
benefit_summary: 100% tuition fee reimbursement plus annual maintenance allowance up to ₹50,000 direct to bank account.
next_action_steps: Obtain Income Certificate certifying family income below ₹2,00,000 (or ₹2.5L for SC/ST).
Get College Bonafide Certificate with course fee breakdown.
Register on scholarship.up.gov.in using Aadhaar OTP authentication.
Submit final printout with photocopies of all documents to your college scholarship counter.

name: Swami Vivekananda Youth Empowerment Scheme (DigiShakti)
hindi_name: स्वामी विवेकानन्द युवा सशक्तिकरण योजना (मुफ्त स्मार्टफोन / टैबलेट)
ministry_or_dept: Department of IT and Electronics, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
benefit_summary: Free 5G/4G Smartphone or Tablet with pre-loaded educational content and government service apps.
next_action_steps: No individual citizen portal application required; verify your enrollment on the DigiShakti university portal.
Submit your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to your college administrative nodal officer.
Receive SMS verification from DigiShakti and attend the distribution camp.

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
benefit_summary: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 credited directly to DBT-enabled bank accounts.
next_action_steps: Ensure land revenue record (Khatauni) is updated in farmer's name.
Complete eKYC on pmkisan.gov.in via Aadhaar OTP or facial recognition app.
Verify Aadhaar NPCI seeding with your bank account.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
hindi_name: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
ministry_or_dept: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefit_summary: Cashless secondary and tertiary health coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 27,000+ empanelled hospitals.
next_action_steps: Check name in SECC 2011 / NFSA database on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or via Ayushman App.
Visit nearest CSC center or District Hospital Ayushman Mitra desk.
Authenticate via biometric Aadhaar e-KYC and download PVC Ayushman Card.

name: UP Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
hindi_name: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री कन्या सुमंगला योजना
ministry_or_dept: Women and Child Development Department, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
benefit_summary: Conditional financial assistance of ₹25,000 in 6 stages from birth to graduation for female students.
next_action_steps: Register on mksy.up.gov.in as Citizen.
Select Stage 6 (for girls enrolled in Degree/Diploma after Class 12).
Upload admission fee receipt, bank passbook, and parent's income affidavit.

name: UP BOCW Sant Ravidas Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
hindi_name: संत रविदास शिक्षा सहायता योजना (श्रमिक छात्रवृत्ति)
ministry_or_dept: Labour Department / UP BOCW Welfare Board
benefit_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹500 to ₹5,000 for children of registered construction workers from Class 1 through Higher Education.
next_action_steps: Ensure parent has an active UP BOCW Shramik registration.
Apply online under Welfare Schemes on upbocw.in.
Submit child's bonafide certificate and bank account for direct monthly stipend transfer.

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Govt of India
benefit_summary: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd), and ₹50,000 (3rd) with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.
next_action_steps: Check vendor survey list or obtain Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Urban Local Body / Nagar Palika.
Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through nearest banking correspondent / CSC.
Loan sanctioned and disbursed within 15 days.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Govt of India
benefit_summary: Deposit-free LPG connection, first refill cylinder, and gas stove provided completely free of charge to adult women of poor households.
next_action_steps: Apply through nearest LPG distributor (Indane, BharatGas, or HP Gas) or online at pmuy.gov.in.
Submit Aadhaar copies of all adult family members residing together.
LPG distributor verifies lack of existing connection and installs stove and cylinder.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry_or_dept: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) / Ministry of Finance
benefit_summary: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60 with nominee corpus protection upon death.
next_action_steps: Visit bank branch where you have a savings account or access net banking/mobile banking.
Submit APY subscriber registration form designating monthly auto-debit contribution (starts from ₹42/month at age 18).
Receive PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) card confirmation via SMS.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts
benefit_summary: High-interest (8.2% p.a.) tax-free sovereign savings scheme for girl child with maturity at age 21 or for higher education at 18.
application_deadline: Up to age 10 of girl child
next_action_steps: Open account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank.
Deposit initial minimum amount of ₹250 with child birth certificate and parent's Aadhaar.
Receive SSY Passbook to track yearly contributions.

name: UP Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
ministry_or_dept: Social Welfare Department, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
benefit_summary: ₹1,000 per month (₹3,000 quarterly) direct cash transfer to senior citizens living below poverty line.
next_action_steps: Apply online on sspy-up.gov.in under Old Age Pension.
Upload Aadhaar, age proof, and income certificate issued by Tehsildar.
Block Development Officer (BDO) or Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) verifies within 30 days.

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
benefit_summary: 100% free industry-certified skill training, free assessment, NSQF certification, and placement assistance with ₹8,000 reward stipend.
next_action_steps: Find nearest PMKVY training center on Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in).
Select desired job role (e.g. Solar Technician, Healthcare Assistant, IT Helpdesk).
Enroll with Aadhaar and start short-term training course.

name: UP Vivah Hetu Anudan Yojana
hindi_name: उत्तर प्रदेश विवाह हेतु अनुदान योजना (शादी अनुदान)
ministry_or_dept: Social Welfare & Backward Classes Welfare Dept, Uttar Pradesh
benefit_summary: One-time financial grant of ₹20,000 for the marriage of daughters belonging to economically weaker families.
application_deadline: Apply within 90 days before or after marriage
next_action_steps: Apply online on shadianudan.upsdc.gov.in.
Upload marriage invitation card and bride's age proof (minimum 18 years, groom minimum 21 years).
Tehsildar approves and amount is credited directly to bride's bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt of India
benefit_summary: ₹1,20,000 financial grant in plain areas (₹1.30L in hilly areas) for pucca house construction + 90 days MGNREGA wages (₹25,000) + ₹12,000 for toilet under SBM.
next_action_steps: Verify registration in Gram Sabha Awaas+ priority list.
Geo-tagging of kutcha house site conducted by Gram Rozgar Sahayak via AwaasApp.
Funds released directly into bank account in 3 construction milestone tranches.

name: Divyangjan Pension Scheme (UP Disability Pension)
ministry_or_dept: Divyangjan Empowerment Department, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
benefit_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000/year) transferred directly to persons with ≥ 40% certified disability.
next_action_steps: Obtain UDID disability card certifying ≥ 40% disability from District CMO.
Apply online on sspy-up.gov.in under Divyang Pension.
District Divyangjan Officer verifies and disburses pension quarterly.
